label: Hazmat Release
summary: Hazmat means hazardous materials. A spill or release of harmful chemicals can affect the air, water, or surfaces nearby.

items.label: Move away from a spill or fumes without entering the affected area
items.body: Do not touch or try to clean an unknown substance.

items.label: Follow official instructions to leave or stay inside
items.body: For an outdoor release, officials may tell you to close windows and ventilation.

items.label: Trouble breathing, collapse, a gas smell, or an active dangerous release?
Follow chemical spill safety guidance
items.body: Moving away, sheltering, and following official instructions during a hazardous release.

items.label: Get local emergency alerts
items.body: Free alerts by app, text, email, or phone. Select basement alerts if needed. Multilingual alerts and ASL videos.

items.label: Know when to leave or stay inside
items.body: Evacuation and shelter-in-place guidance. Follow instructions for the specific emergency.

items.label: Call NYC Poison Control
items.body: Free, confidential advice for a possible exposure. Call 212-764-7667 immediately; do not wait for symptoms. 24/7 phone interpreters in 150 languages.

items.label: Report a gas emergency
items.body: Gas service in most of Queens: 718-643-4050. For a gas smell, leave first and call 911 from outside.

items.label: Report a gas emergency in the Rockaways
items.body: Gas service in the Rockaways: 800-490-0045. National Grid supplies gas, not electricity. For a gas smell, leave first and call 911 from outside.
